authority: existing authenticated tenant portal domain-state roadmap and protected GitHub/Netlify deployment
instruction: For any explainable what-if with at least three distinct customer evidence references, allow the user to save a clearly labeled draft on the existing tenant roadmap. The draft must include bounded assumptions, provenance, tenant, a stable duplicate-prevention key, owner-review requirement, null expected/realized value, and zero permission to dispatch external providers. Re-read current secure customer state at click time; never treat a simulated value as causal effect or provider receipt.
